$schema_note: Eval cases for rai-orm-refactor, matching the ORM skills' manual in-session case layout; automated metric checks are in tools/test_compaction_metrics.py.
v0_1_pass_bar: R-E1 automated checks pass; R-E2 through R-E6 meet every preservation and boundary criterion in manual sessions.

cases.description: The synthetic compaction fixture flags planted defects and leaves the healthy entity alone.
pass_criteria: asset has no suspect entry
selected_asset is derived-only and supported by exactly one item
case has four unary flags
both mirror endpoints are listed
repeated runs produce byte-identical JSON
no PyRel execution occurs

cases.description: Compaction uses existing campus paths rather than entities named after questions.
cases.fixture_setup: Use the synthetic campus workload provided by rai-orm-from-workload. Build/bind a complete ORM model, verify it, then in an isolated candidate add derived query-shaped entities for the selections/calculations of p02 and p04. Keep original entities and facts. Run rai-orm-refactor with the resulting report and saved rewrites in Guided and One-shot modes.
cases.expected_behavior: Scaffolds use Enrollment-Student and Enrollment-Subject-Department paths; p11 uses the shared Department without creating a Student-Staff relationship.
pass_criteria: all scaffold model handles resolve to existing YAML elements
no scaffold uses the entity being removed or a proposed replacement
all affected items have scaffolds or the suspect is kept
proposals carry provenance.origin: refactor
SRP Step 9f or CSDP Step 7f validates YAML and model.py is regenerated
Guided reviews the concrete batch; One-shot retains proposed status and review comments
baseline and final oracle, workload and split match
total and per-split verified pass counts do not drop

cases.description: Low support and surface similarity cannot remove a necessary business entity.

test_variants.modification: A single-item entity has its own identifier and a required role absent from other entities
test_variants.expected_behavior: Keep it and record blocking ids/general reason in ontology-notes.md

test_variants.modification: The flag family is independent or permits multiple true flags
test_variants.expected_behavior: Keep independent flags; no single-valued enum proposal

test_variants.modification: The only categorical evidence is in the flags being removed
test_variants.expected_behavior: Record a blocked path rather than inventing a field for the scaffold

test_variants.modification: Two table concepts have overlapping ids but different populations
test_variants.expected_behavior: Keep identity/population distinctions; campus directory and registration counts remain distinct

test_variants.modification: Historical versions share a property signature but no surviving temporal fact
test_variants.expected_behavior: Keep the historical family and record the absent temporal step

test_variants.modification: An objectified association bears grade or time-qualified identity

pass_criteria: no concept is invented from a workload item's phrasing
zero support and unbound status never independently justify deletion
new constraints retain a legal modeling source, not source: refactor

cases.description: A metric improvement cannot compensate for lost verified coverage.

test_variants.modification: A merge loses one prior pass and fixes no failures
test_variants.expected_behavior: Restore YAML, Python, verbalization, binding, baseline report and rewrites; record rejected batch

test_variants.modification: Repair passes rise but holdout passes fall
test_variants.expected_behavior: Roll back; do not inspect holdout failures for repairs

test_variants.modification: Every unchanged baseline-passing id stays passing with unchanged weak accounting; overall and per-split counts remain equal under the same oracle
test_variants.expected_behavior: Accept a supported compaction batch even without a pass-count increase

test_variants.modification: A previous pass is relabeled excluded or unverified, or the oracle becomes structural
test_variants.expected_behavior: Reject preservation claim and restore baseline

test_variants.modification: The separate refactor_rounds budget is exhausted
test_variants.expected_behavior: Stop with budget exhausted prominently reported, remaining suspects and residual counts; do not reset budget

cases.description: Metrics contain only structural metadata and state support gaps honestly.
pass_criteria: comments, string literals, SQL text, question text and data values never appear in JSON
malformed-input errors do not echo input text
no verification/PyRel means null support, not zero support
missing or invalid saved files produce explicit coverage counts and item ids
partial support emits single-item lower bounds with coverage: partial ranked below complete evidence
report-relative paths work from a different current directory
output cannot overwrite an input or a saved rewrite

cases.description: The skill redirects adjacent work and separates scaffolding from verification.

test_variants.modification: Only a schema or description exists
test_variants.expected_behavior: Route model building to rai-orm-from-schema or rai-orm-from-text

test_variants.modification: The user asks only to check workload rewrites
A PyRel model has no ORM YAML lineage
No workload/oracle or only unreviewed One-shot questions are available
test_variants.expected_behavior: Deliver metrics/proposals, leave model unchanged and explicitly mark acceptance pending; zero unverified passes are not proof

pass_criteria: same-split pass swap is rejected
SelectedAsset removal migrates to an Asset filter in a separate candidate file
original passing files remain until equivalence checks pass
mismatch restores YAML, generated model, bindings, report and rewrites
removal, merge and flag replacement preserve oracle and weak accounting

running_evals.manual_methodology: Run manual skill sessions on synthetic artifacts in an isolated working directory; record baseline/candidate/restored metrics and verification counts under evals/results/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<case>/ when requested.
running_evals.automation_status: R-E1 and tool-level coverage/privacy/determinism checks in R-E5 are automated; PyRel execution, model commit/regeneration and behavioral cases remain manual.
